jobToBeDone: Practice foundational Kubernetes and cloud-native decisions across architecture, orchestration, delivery, observability, and security without treating Patternly practice as an official certification outcome.
targetLearner: A learner entering cloud-native operations or development who wants scenario-based foundations practice and durable review of Kubernetes and ecosystem decisions.

contentScopes: Complete cloud-native foundations node covering cluster roles, workload intent, declarative operation, and observable outcomes.
Whole-node packages based on reviewed objectives, operational competencies, remediation needs, and a sourced simulation profile.
provenanceRules: Kubernetes, cloud-native, and exam-specific facts require current attributable CNCF or project public sources before content release.
Content is independently authored, excludes exam dumps, and does not claim CNCF affiliation or an official score.
